'''Mid Rim Ornate''' was a style of architecture prevalent on [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin's mansion|waterfront home]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] was said to be a blend of [[Core Classic]] and Mid Rim Ornate architectural style.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
